name: Sail vane

behaviour.info: Free thrust in wind, no fuel; weak in storms

pros: Thrust from wind: no fuel, no engine
balanceNote: Skyreach Concord signature part (09 §3): free thrust in wind, weak in storms. Declared as family "sail", variant "vane" so that the requested id sail_vane satisfies the checker's family_variant rule; there is no std sail to compare with, so the stats are the request's.
notes: Faction signature part (design/09). Art: ivory ribbed fin sail with brass battens and a P2-painted panel, P3 trim along the leech, slim brass-hooped mast, boom and sheet to a deck winch, P1 mast step. The sail is the moving group (role turret, pivot on the mast) so the game can swing it to the wind.
